title: docs(spec, skills): a queried composite record title is a stored computed field, not a formula; a stored field's expression is the engine's, never a client hint
body:
Fixes #25129

Clause-②: no
Metadata-protocol: none

**Governance: Tier H.** This diff touches `skills/**` (the published `objectstack-data` skill), a governed surface, so it lands only on an authorized APPROVED review. It stays a draft until then; the relay's `pr_create` requests the governed review itself.

## What changes

Ruling 6308445871 (#24981, letter A), item 2: "The producer stores the title it needs to query: a composite title that must round-trip through import is a stored computed field (a non-formula field with an `expression`, written on write — the #24619 shape), the remedy ADR-0079 item 9 already prescribes for sort and search." PR #25127 (#25071) re-worded the record-title lint, ADR-0079 D3 and `formulas.mdx` to that shape. This PR finishes the same reconciliation on the copies that card did not claim, and keeps "a text formula title stays legal for display only".

| Site | Before | After |
|---|---|---|
| `packages/spec/src/data/object.zod.ts`, the `titleFormat` describe | "Migrate a single-field title to nameField, a composite to a formula field designated as nameField." | a composite title that import, sort or search must match → a stored computed field (a non-formula field with an expression, computed and stored on every write) designated as nameField; a text formula designated as nameField stays legal for a title shown for display only |
| `content/docs/references/data/object.mdx`, `references/api/metadata.mdx`, `references/system/migration.mdx` (two rows) | generated copies of that describe | regenerated with `pnpm --filter @objectstack/spec check:generated --fix` after the build; the diff is the four `titleFormat` rows and nothing else |
| `packages/spec/src/system/metadata-form-zod-reconciliation.test.ts`, the `titleFormat` omit-ledger note | quotes the old describe | quotes the new prescription; "every target is authorable" |
| `skills/objectstack-data/SKILL.md`, `nameField` row | "or a formula field (`returnType: 'text'`) for a composite title" | "a composite title to import, sort or search by is a stored computed field (a non-`formula` field with an `expression`, computed and stored on write); a text formula is display-only" |
| `skills/objectstack-data/SKILL.md`, `titleFormat` row | "for a composite title, designate a `returnType: 'text'` formula field as `nameField`" | "a composite title follows the `nameField` row" |
| `skills/objectstack-data/rules/relationships.md`, the "Computed column" bullet (seat pointer 6333459023) | "the server only treats `type: 'formula'` as computed, so on a stored field the `expression` is a client compute hint and the sent value is stored verbatim" | "the engine computes a stored field's `expression` from the row the write stores and stores the result, so a client-sent value never stands" |

The `nameField` describe carries no composite-to-formula prescription (measured; the dispatch's H2 is falsified for that site). Its TSDoc lists "formula→text" among the stored title fields, D1's wording that ADR-0079's addendum qualifies without editing; it prescribes nothing for a composite title and is left alone.

## The shape is real on origin/main

- `FieldSchema.expression` describe (`packages/spec/src/data/field.zod.ts`): "On any other (stored) field: computed by the engine from the row the write stores and stored, so a client-sent value never stands".
- `packages/objectql/src/engine.ts` `planStoredExpressions` / `replacedStoredExpressionFields`; `packages/spec/src/contracts/data-engine.ts`: since #25000 a `strictReadonlyWrites` write whose value such a field's expression replaces is refused, and a non-strict one is reported under `stored_expression`.
- ADR-0079 addendum item 9: a formula value is stored nowhere; a sort by it is refused, search cannot reach it; an object that must sort or search by a composite title stores it.

## Sweep (H2, H3)

- `packages/spec/src/**`: "composite" with "formula", "nameField" or "title" → the describe and the reconciliation note only (control word `titleFormat`: 10 files, none a prescription).
- `skills/**`: "composite" with "formula", "title" or "nameField" → the two SKILL.md rows only; "compute hint", "stored verbatim", "only treats", "as computed" → the relationships.md bullet only (control word `titleFormat`: 3 hits; the other two are the formula skill's template table and a query-filter example, neither a prescription). `rules/field-types.md:124` already says a `formula` is virtual, consistent with the new text.
- Repo-wide outside the card: the old sentence survives only in `packages/*/CHANGELOG.md` (release-owned; never edited in a code PR) and in two test docblocks describing landed in-repo migrations (`packages/services/service-messaging/src/objects/notification-display-title.test.ts:18`, `packages/platform-objects/src/identity/identity-display-title.test.ts:17`), the in-repo `display_title` formulas the card excludes.

## skills/** readings

So the skill half owes a changeset; it rides in the same file as the spec half.

The first re-wording of the `nameField` row put `SKILL.md` 48 tokens over its ceiling (`6171 / 6123`). Paid in the same file by deletion, never by re-wrap: the two re-worded rows tightened; the incident sentence "It used to clear both and then never match." dropped; the parenthetical "(Reminder: two consecutive `os build` runs with no source change must be byte-identical — see the determinism gate above.)" dropped, because that gate lives in `references/seeds.md`, not above; a doubled `---` separator removed. No ceiling moved.

Declared narrowing: the spec suite is 779 files, over the foreground cap; only the reconciliation note pins the changed text and no test reads the `titleFormat` describe; CI's `Test Core` runs the whole suite.

## Changeset

`.changeset/25129-composite-title-stored-field.md`: `@objectstack/spec` `patch` and `@objectstack/skills` `patch`, `Clause-②: no`, `Metadata-protocol: none`. The text an author reads changes; no key, type, default or accepted value does.

## Acceptance notes

- The `nameField` TSDoc's "(text / autonumber / formula→text)" lists a formula among the "real stored" title fields, D1's wording that the ADR-0079 addendum qualifies without editing; it prescribes nothing and is not in scope. Noted, not filed.
- The two in-repo test docblocks and the CHANGELOG entries named under Sweep keep the old sentence as a description of landed migrations; the card excludes those packages. Noted, not filed.

## 维护者速读(草稿)

- **改了什么**:`titleFormat` 的 describe(及其三页生成的参考文档)、引用它的表单对账注记,以及已发布的 `objectstack-data` 技能包里 `nameField` / `titleFormat` 两行和「Computed column」一条。措辞统一为:需要被导入匹配、排序或搜索的组合标题应使用存储型计算字段(非 formula 字段加 `expression`,写入时由引擎计算并落库);text formula 标题仍合法,但只用于展示。「Computed column」改为:存储字段的 `expression` 由引擎按写入行计算并落库,客户端送来的值不作数。
- **为什么改**:旧文案把作者引向 formula 标题,而 formula 值不落库,导致排序被拒、搜索够不到、导入无法按标题匹配(ADR-0079 补充第 9 条与裁决 6308445871);PR #25127 已改了 lint 与 ADR,这是同一次对账剩下的几处。技能包里「expression 只是客户端提示、值按送达原样存储」与 main 上的引擎行为相反,是 AI 作者在同一个包里读到的自相矛盾。
- **风险与代价(含回滚)**:仅文案;无键、类型、默认值或接受值变化;技能包行数净 −4,token 在天花板内(6099/6123),天花板未动;为付 token 账删掉的三处都是失效指引或事故叙述。回滚即还原本 PR。
- **席位意见**:
- **你要做的**:本 PR 触及 `skills/**`,属 Tier H,需要一次授权的 APPROVED 评审后才能落地。
